searchText: I think this can be even generalized to "how can we in general fund public goods that benefit the ecosystem/network?" I'm not sure of how is the best way to be honest. But I do like how monero does their Community Crowdfunding System. Some well known devs/team usually put up a funding request to fund their work for the network, even without specific milestones Think the challenge lies more to the fact that the devs of these systems need to be able to decide on a budget/funding requirement that will be able to sustain them We actually have an advantage in which we can donate in stable coins 🙂 so that should help in terms of stability of the funding Feels like we can utilize the gitcoin grant to do this so as to not create too many different systems
